title: Restriction comparison for mixed total tensor

from.place: proof of Tag 0DJ8: choose K-flat models for derived tensor over R; restriction comparison needed for the fixed-second-factor tensor construction

statement: Let $R,A$ be commutative rings and $f:R\to A$ a ring homomorphism. Let $S$ be degreewise restriction of scalars on cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and $B(E,N)$ the flipped mixed total tensor [def-pc-mixed-total-tensor], with $E$ first. There is a natural isomorphism of bifunctors $S(B(E,N))\cong E\otimes_R S(N)$, natural in both complexes. No K-flatness or flatness of $A$ over $R$ is assumed.

proof.text: On coefficient modules use TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange and TensorProduct.comm: n tensor (a tensor e) maps to e tensor a n. The inverse sends e tensor n to n tensor (1 tensor e). Prove naturality on pure tensors in both variables; linearity extends it to all tensors.

Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents twice to assemble the coefficient isomorphisms into an isomorphism of bicomplexes. Naturality from step 1 is precisely compatibility with each differential.

Restriction preserves coproducts, so HomologicalComplex₂.mapTotalIso compares restriction after totalization with totalization after restriction. Compose its inverse with total.mapIso of the bicomplex comparison. Total-map functoriality and mapTotalIso_inv_naturality prove naturality in both variables. Assemble these comparisons using NatIso.ofComponents twice.

theorem exists_mixedTensor_restriction_iso {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    (f : R →+* A) :
    let S := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let B := (ModuleCat.mixedTensor f).flip.map₂CochainComplex
    Nonempty (B ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj S ≅
      curriedTensor (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj S)
